Use this template only after running the local `report-issue` workflow and reviewing the generated draft for sensitive data.

Do not paste credentials, signing keys, tokens, private addresses, private paths, or unredacted logs.

## Sanitized report

Paste the reviewed contents of the local issue draft here, or summarize it and attach only explicitly approved sanitized evidence.
